description: User directed 2026-11-19: "add the elixir parity issues as tickets to the epic we gave to Elixir Parity". Owner: Elixir Parity. Found by Elixir Parity building fz-nhb.5. runtime/src/escape.rs:130 accepts \\x with one hex digit and \\x{H...}; Elixir (elixir_interpolation.erl:221-226) accepts only \\xHH and raises 'invalid hex escape character, expected \\xHH' otherwise, so fz accepts programs Elixir rejects. Predates nhb.5 (moved, not written). Done: \\x accepts exactly Elixir's forms; a self-check fixture covers the rejected ones.
title: A string escape reads only what Elixir's does
